what: the makers' documents task L4-E13 read on 2 October 2026 while looking for a 12 V class panel whose maker prints an open-circuit voltage tolerance, and why each was not taken as one of the two further candidates; every file was fetched with curl from the runner, read, and is cited here by its address and sha256 only (none is filed: none states terms that clearly allow redistribution). The figures are as printed; 'nominal at -20 C' is Voc x (1 + 45 K x |coefficient|), the sheet's typical values, for the screen only

rows.document: SOLBIANFLEX SP series datasheet, English, created 12 October 2023
rows.printed: 110 W, Vmp 19.6 V, Voc 23.3 V, Isc 6.0 A, Voc -0.28 %/C, NOCT 45 +- 2 C, 32 Maxeon cells, 1.5 kg, power tolerance (0%, +5%); no Voc tolerance
rows.why_not: above 25 V at -20 C on its typical values already

rows.document: SOLBIANFLEX SP series datasheet, created 14 December 2020, modified 13 July 2021
rows.printed: 104 W (+- 5%), Vmp 18.2 V, Voc 21.8 V, Isc 6.0 A, Voc -0.28 %/C, NOCT 45 +- 2 C, 32 cells; no Voc tolerance
rows.why_not: no Voc tolerance printed; the maker's 2023 issue lists the 32-cell SP model as the SP 32 at Voc 23.3 V instead

rows.document: SOLBIANFLEX SR series datasheet, English, created 24 October 2023
rows.printed: 160 W, Vmp 16.8 V, Voc 21.3 V, Isc 9.8 A, Voc -0.32 %/C, NOCT 45 +- 2 C, 32 cells, 2.3 kg; no Voc tolerance
rows.why_not: no Voc tolerance printed; the same Voc as the SX 156 with a maximum-power voltage 0.8 V lower and a short-circuit current of 9.8 A at the entry's 10 A; the SX 156 is the better hold match of the two

rows.document: SOLBIANFLEX SX series datasheet, created 17 February 2021
rows.printed: 158 W (0%, +5%), Vmp 17.4 V, Voc 21.3 V, Isc 9.5 A, Voc -0.32 %/C, NOCT 45 +- 2 C, 32 cells; no Voc tolerance
rows.why_not: the earlier issue of the SX 32-cell model; the maker's 2023 issue (the SX 156, the candidate) supersedes it

rows.document: SOLBIANFLEX SR series datasheet, created 2 November 2017
rows.printed: 144 W, Vmp 16.7 V, Voc 20.4 V, Isc 9.0 A, Voc -0.27 %/C, 32 cells; no Voc tolerance
rows.why_not: superseded by the 2023 SR series (SR 32 above); no Voc tolerance printed

rows.document: Solbian installation manual v4, created 7 September 2011
rows.printed: Peak Power (+/- 5%) only; no Voc tolerance
rows.why_not: read for a Voc tolerance; none is printed

rows.document: eArche 12 V datasheet SMFU_UNC_EN_2019B, created 2 August 2019
rows.printed: 90 W, Vmp 16.7 V, Voc 21.1 V, Isc 5.64 A, 32 cells, power tolerance 0/+5 W; no temperature coefficient and no Voc tolerance
rows.why_not: no Voc coefficient and no Voc tolerance printed (2019 issue)

rows.document: Sunman RV and marine flexible panel installation guide, created 12 December 2023
rows.printed: Voc 25.2, 23.9 and 24.9 V at STC; power tolerance 0/+5W
rows.why_not: every 12 V model listed is at or near 25 V at STC already

rows.printed: Vmp 23.35 V at 100 W; 'The electrical characteristics are within +/- 10% unless otherwise specified'; Voc not in the text layer
rows.why_not: a 24 V class panel; its maker's band is 10 %

rows.printed: Vmp 34.2 V, Voc 40.8 V, Voc -0.28 %/C; power tolerance 0~+5W

rows.document: SOLA Flex Mono datasheet, Stand v1025
rows.model: SOLA Flex Mono 100 Wp and 135 Wp
rows.printed: Uoc 34.32 V and 31.08 V; Uoc -0.25 %/C; NOCT 45 +- 2 C

rows.document: ST-100Q-12Y data sheet drawing, V1 of 27 May 2024
rows.printed: Voc 22.12 V, Vmp 19.23 V, Isc 5.50 A, Imp 5.21 A, 33 cells; no coefficient, no tolerance on the electrical rows
rows.why_not: no temperature coefficient and no Voc tolerance printed

rows.document: BlueSolar Monocrystalline Panels datasheet (byte-identical to the copy in the tree, v2/vendor/solar/victron-bluesolar-monocrystalline-panels-datasheet-en.pdf)
rows.why_not: above 25 V at -20 C on its typical values already (the 150W-12V row; every 12 V row higher); rigid glass
